about.description:
Memray is a memory profiler for Python. It can track memory allocations in
Python code, in native extension modules, and in the Python interpreter
itself. It can generate several different types of reports to help you
analyze the captured memory usage data. While commonly used as a CLI tool,
it can also be used as a library to perform more fine-grained profiling
tasks.
about.summary: Memray is a memory profiler for Python

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: memray
  version: "1.20.0"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/m/memray/memray-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: ce1f1d900948d57d7db5b5d8d81f4ebfcb798eff674493503ce5bfaafcea84dc

build:
  number: 0
  skip: win
  script:
    - if: aarch64
      then:
        - export CFLAGS="${CFLAGS} -pthread"
        - export LDFLAGS="${LDFLAGS} -pthread"
    - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - cython
    - cmake
    - make
    - pkgconfig
  host:
    - if: linux
      then:
        - elfutils
        - libunwind
    - python
    - pip
    - scikit-build-core >=0.9
    - pkgconfig
    - cython >=3.1
    - lz4-c
  run:
    - python
    - rich >=11.2.0
    - jinja2
    - textual >=0.41.0

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - memray
      pip_check: true
  - script:
      - memray -h

about:
  summary: Memray is a memory profiler for Python
  description: |
    Memray is a memory profiler for Python. It can track memory allocations in
    Python code, in native extension modules, and in the Python interpreter
    itself. It can generate several different types of reports to help you
    analyze the captured memory usage data. While commonly used as a CLI tool,
    it can also be used as a library to perform more fine-grained profiling
    tasks.
  license: Apache-2.0 AND BSD-3-Clause
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - src/vendor/libbacktrace/LICENSE
  homepage: https://github.com/bloomberg/memray
  repository: https://github.com/bloomberg/memray
  documentation: https://bloomberg.github.io/memray/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - matthiasdiener
    - pb01ka
